'''Kiyr Gir'sku''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] who was one of the most prominent organic members of the [[Droid Equality Foundation]], a large and powerful [[Droid/Legends|droid]] rights group. A master litigator, Gir'sku took on large court cases on the Foundation's behalf. Gir'sku was unaware that Foundation's true purpose was to bring about the destruction of all droids and [[Jolor Oron]], the leader of the Droid Equality Foundation, viewed her as a tool that he could exploit.
